decision.title: XSLT per-package items, an absent global focus through call-template, namespace undeclarations (packet 4.31)

body.p: , after , , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug preset (xslt, cli, function_library, processor, xquery, xpath, evaluator, ir tests), clang-tidy on the changed files, the call-cycle check, the QT4 sets the loader and fn:function-lookup touch (XQ40/XP40 fn-function-lookup, fn-doc, fn-doc-available, fn-collection, prod-ModuleImport: equal to docs/CONFORMANCE.md), and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver after each change, case by case. XT40 12,268 to 12,273 passed (99 to 98 wrong error), 250 to 245 failed, 0 errors, no case lost, from a whole run at fdff1ee. No public header changed. Commits 4df51df, bb89091.

item.p: Namespace undeclarations need no tree change: 's sketch was wrong. The tree has stored an element that does not inherit its parent's namespaces since (sxml_element_start_event's ignores_parent_namespaces; copies send undeclarations for the descendants, sxml_tree_builder_copy_node), and XSLT's inherit-namespaces="no" (xsl:element, xsl:copy, literal result elements; 5.7.1, 11.1.2) and XQuery's copy-namespaces no-inherit use it. Probed: in-scope-prefixes of namespace-2606's b and c are right, and its serialization (XML 1.1, undeclare-prefixes) is the expected file's byte for byte except whitespace. namespace-2606 fails only because its expected file is indented while the stylesheet does not indent (assert-xml compares whitespace text nodes): the suite decides, left. So does document-2402 (its overriding template "a" has no visibility, so it is private, 3.4.5.3, and no initial template: XTDE0040, 2.4.4; document-2401, which says public, passes).

An absent global focus through xsl:call-template (3.4.9, 10.1.2, 11.9.1): a call from a global, whose focus is the global context item, is if (exists(try { item } catch err:XPDY0002 { () })) then template(item, 1, 1, ...) else template-absent((), 0, 0, ...), the template's absent-focus function () chosen at run time; an XSLT error mapping with no raised code catches to the empty sequence (copy-4308: XTTE0945).

fn:map-for-key#2 (20.2.3: "If the argument is omitted or empty, the selected subtree is the document containing the context node"): $top is node()? and the caller's context value is passed after it, the empty sequence where the focus is statically absent ('s is_empty_without_focus); none gives XTDE1270 (map-for-key-005). Left: in a global whose global context item is absent at run time, reading it for the hidden argument raises XPDY0002 even with $top given.

Accumulators per package (3.5.3.1, 19.8): an accumulator's definition records its package; XTSE3350 compares declarations of one package; each package has its own fn:accumulator-before and -after (as fn:key, ), which test its accumulators' names only; use-accumulators names those of its element's package (override-misc-005, -007).
The package of a static context: sxml_ir_static_context gains package_number (the index of the package's top module, sxml_xslt_package_top_module; 0 outside XSLT), set on each XSLT module. Two uses:

fn:document and fn:doc strip by their package's xsl:strip-space (4.2.2): sxml_document_request.preparation_number selects the preparation (sxml_preparation_request, an internal operations change), the loader keeps one document per URI and preparation, and the stripping filter collects the declarations of that package only; the principal source document is the top-level package's (document-2401).

fn:function-lookup by visibility (10.3.5: only a function in the static context of the call): sxml_ir_function.is_private for a private or hidden stylesheet function; the unit-function search takes one of the caller's package first, then one of another package that is not private (function-lookup-004). XQuery is unchanged (one package, nothing private); its %private functions could use the same flag.

Not done, with causes and sizes: function-lookup-005 (from a used package, a public function of a package it does not use, and an abstract one overridden there, are found: the IR would need the packages' use relation, small to medium; the suite's effect="7" for an overridden function is what sxml gives); import-schema-216 (schema roles kept apart: one schema per role and per-static-context in-scope schemas by the nearest [xsl:]schema-role, also for type names and validation, medium to large, only this case fails); merge-when (no suite case) and 's current rule in an attribute set inside xsl:for-each (an evaluator operation, no case) were not cheap, left; streaming ('s sketch) is a later packet.
Records: the scratchpad was emptied by another session during the packet; the baseline was run again at fdff1ee. The XT40 section of docs/CONFORMANCE.md was not regenerated.
